scope: Original concise era-75 articles for remaining unavailable Eden titles. No post-75 acquisition methods or imported Horizon-only stat adjustments.

articles.title: Zoredonite
articles.intro: Uragnite notorious monster encountered aboard the Manaclipper.
articles.body_html:
Find and fight

  1. Board the Manaclipper and watch the deck during the voyage. This NM appears naturally; it is not fished up.
  2. It can appear on any route and attacks level-75 characters. Claim it before it disappears.
  3. Prepare poison removal for Gas Shell and Venom Shell. It can use Invincible and cast Flash and cures.

Drops

Possible rewards include Nebimonite Belt, Zoredonite Ring, Healing Mace, Kosshin, Seashell.

articles.title: Zikko
articles.intro: Level-80 imp notorious monster in Caedarva Mire.
articles.body_html:
Find and fight

Search the marsh pools between Alzadaal Undersea Ruins and Dvucca Isle Staging Point in Caedarva Mire. It may appear when a player crossing the marsh receives Weight; it is not a normal placeholder camp. The reported respawn delay is about two hours.

Prepare for damaging area Silence and Amnesia attacks, shadow removal, Manafont and Sleepga II.

Drops

Templar Hammer and Immortal's Sash are possible drops.

articles.title: Zinc Ore
articles.intro: Crafting ore also required by several early quests.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

Farm Tunnel Worm or Stone Eater in the Gustaberg areas. Other options include mining in Zeruhn Mines, Palborough Mines and Gusgen Mines, or buying from the Auction House under Materials → Goldsmithing. Teerth in Bastok Markets also stocks it when available.

Uses

Used for Brass Ingot, Paktong Ingot and Zinc Oxide. Quest uses include Shady Business, Beauty and the Galka and The Medicine Woman.

articles.title: Zircon
articles.intro: Gemstone used in Goldsmithing earrings and rings.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

Goldsmithing 20: use a Wind Crystal with one Translucent Rock. Zircon is the HQ2 result, so the ordinary result is not Zircon. Other sources include Clockwork Pod in Fei'Yin, Skull of Sloth in The Eldieme Necropolis, and treasure coffers in Quicksand Caves.

Uses and purchase

Used to craft Zircon Earring and Zircon Ring. Buy under Auction House → Materials → Goldsmithing, or check the Goldsmiths’ Guild stock in Bastok Markets.

articles.title: Zoredonite Ring
articles.intro: Level-56 ring for all jobs: MP +20 and INT +1.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

  1. Ride the Manaclipper.
  2. Defeat Zoredonite when it appears on deck. The ring is a possible drop.

Trading

Rare/Exclusive: obtain your own drop; it cannot be purchased on the Auction House.

articles.title: Zoolater Hat
articles.intro: Level-73 Beastmaster head armor: DEF 19; enchanted pet Meditate.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

  1. Go to Attohwa Chasm.
  2. Defeat the notorious monster Xolotl for a chance at the hat.

Use

The enchantment grants Meditate to your pet. The hat has 50 charges and a 30-minute reuse timer. It cannot be bought through the Auction House.

articles.title: Zephyr Mantle
articles.intro: Level-65 Blue Magic that creates four Blink-like shadows on the caster.
articles.body_html:
Learn it

  1. Fight Puk in Wajaom Woodlands or Mamook, or Sea Puk in Mamook or Bhaflau Thickets.
  2. Let the monster use Zephyr Mantle, then defeat it while eligible to learn Blue Magic. Learning is not guaranteed.

Spell details

31 MP; 2 Blue Magic set points; AGI +2 when set. Casting time: 7 seconds. Recast: 60 seconds. Maximum duration: 5 minutes. Pair with a suitable spell such as Chaotic Eye for Conserve MP. These are Blink-style shadows, not guaranteed Utsusemi absorption.

articles.title: Zushio
articles.intro: Level-40 Ninja katana: original-era DMG 23, delay 238 and STR +2.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

Complete 20 in Pirate Years, the first Ninja artifact quest. The quest also awards Anju. Open the quest for its prerequisite, NPC and fight route.

Equipment

Rare/Exclusive quest weapon. The Horizon-specific increase to DMG 25 is not assumed for Zenith.

articles.title: Zvahl Coffer Key
articles.intro: Opens a treasure coffer in Castle Zvahl Baileys.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

Defeat Abyssal Demon, Arch Demon, Blood Demon, Doom Demon, Ahriman in Castle Zvahl Baileys. These are the higher-level demon and eye enemies, not the low-level chest-key targets.

Use

Trade the key to a Treasure Coffer. Rewards depend on active quests and job conditions. Uses include Fighter's Cuisses, Rogue's Vest, Borghertz's Harmonious Hands and Under Oath. Activate the relevant artifact quest and follow its instructions before opening the coffer.

articles.title: Zephyr Thread
articles.intro: Clothcraft tool consumed by bulk fletching recipes.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

Buy from Meriri at the Weavers’ Guild in Windurst Woods or Taten-Bilten in Al Zahbi. Also listed under Auction House → Materials → Clothcraft.

Use

Used with the Fletching guild ability to make batches of fletchings. Choose the recipe for your feather type, such as Bird Fletchings, Yagudo Fletchings or Puk Fletchings.

articles.title: Zunari Kabuto
articles.intro: Level-44 Samurai head armor with DEF 15.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

Craft with Smithing 69 and Clothcraft 34: Fire Crystal + 2 Iron Sheets + 1 Copper Ingot + 1 Silk Thread + 1 Silk Cloth. The high-quality result is Zunari Kabuto +1.

Uses

Buy under Auction House → Armor → Head. The ordinary kabuto is also an ingredient for Cursed Kabuto.

articles.title: Zeruhn Soot
articles.intro: Quest material dropped by the original low-level monsters in Zeruhn Mines.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

Defeat Ding Bats, Tunnel Worm, Mouse Bat, River Crab, Leech in Zeruhn Mines. It is also tradable through Auction House → Others → Miscellaneous.

Quest use

Collect soot for Minesweeper. Open that quest for the NPC, required amount and reward.

articles.title: Zincite
articles.intro: Mineral used to make Moblin Putty.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

Defeat Glacier Eater or the notorious monster Mountain Worm in Uleguerand Range. Also sold by players under Auction House → Materials → Alchemy.

Use

Ingredient for Moblin Putty (Alchemy 33). It does not stack.

articles.title: Ziz Meat
articles.intro: Cooking ingredient obtained from Ziz in Mamook.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

Defeat Ziz or Zizzy Zillah in Mamook. It can also be purchased from players under Auction House → Food → Ingredients.

Uses

Original recipes include Zoni, Meat Mithkabob, Pet Food Epsilon Biscuit and Ic Pilav. Check each recipe for the crystal and remaining ingredients.

articles.title: Zvahl Chest Key
articles.intro: Opens a treasure chest in Castle Zvahl; it is different from the coffer key.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

Fight Demon Pawn, Demon Knight, Demon Wizard or Demon Warlock in Castle Zvahl Baileys or Castle Zvahl Keep. Several other beastmen in the Keep also drop it.

Use

Trade to a Treasure Chest for treasure. With A Test of True Love active, the quest reward can take priority. For artifact coffers, obtain Zvahl Coffer Key instead.

articles.title: Zoraal Ja's Axe
articles.intro: Level-74 axe for WAR, DRK, BST and RNG: DMG 46, delay 276; Reward healing +10%.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

Defeat Zoraal Ja's Pkuucha in Wajaom Woodlands for a chance at this axe. It can also be bought under Auction House → Weapons → Axes.

Use

Equip it when using Reward to improve the HP restored to your pet.

articles.title: Zeta Sash
articles.intro: Level-75 waist equipment: DEF 6, Attack +10; an additional critical-hit bonus while in Salvage.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

  1. Reach Second Lieutenant Assault rank.
  2. Complete Wake the Puppet in the Periqia Assault area.
  3. Obtain and appraise the ??? Sash reward for a chance at Zeta Sash.

Jobs

WAR, RDM, THF, PLD, DRK, BST, BRD, RNG, SAM, NIN, DRG, BLU, COR and DNC. Rare/Exclusive; cannot be bought at the Auction House.

articles.title: Zinc Oxide
articles.intro: Goldsmithing product used in Sieglinde Putty.
articles.body_html:
Craft it

Goldsmithing 1: Fire Crystal + 3 Zinc Ore → 1 Zinc Oxide.

Uses and purchase

Ingredient for Sieglinde Putty (Alchemy 30). Buy the finished powder under Auction House → Materials → Alchemy.

articles.title: Zircon Earring
articles.intro: Level-49 earring for all jobs: Ice resistance +6 and Wind resistance +6.
articles.body_html:
Craft it

Goldsmithing 65: Earth Crystal + 1 Gold Earring + 1 Zircon. The standard result is Zircon Earring; high-quality outcomes are Genius Earring or Genius Earring +1.

Purchase

Auction House → Armor → Earrings. A second recipe uses Gold Earring +1 at Goldsmithing 70.

articles.title: Ziska's Crossbow
articles.intro: Level-71 crossbow for THF and RNG: DMG 28, delay 216, Ranged Accuracy +8.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

Possible reward from Cactuar Suave or Eye of the Storm in Chamber of Oracles. Open the battlefield page for the required orb and enemy strategy.

Purchase

Tradable through Auction House → Weapons → Ranged.

articles.title: Zenith Crown
articles.intro: Level-73 head equipment for WHM, BLM, RDM, BRD and SMN. DEF 30, INT +3, MND +3; enhanced Resist Silence; converts 50 HP to MP.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

  1. Obtain Aquarian Abjuration: Head; original sources include Byakko.
  2. Obtain Cursed Crown through crafting or the Auction House.
  3. Trade the abjuration and cursed item together to Alphollon C Meriard inside the cathedral in Northern San d'Oria.

Result

The uncursed armor is Rare/Exclusive. Use the linked cursed-item page for its crafting recipe.

articles.title: Zenith Crown +1
articles.intro: Level-73 head equipment for WHM, BLM, RDM, BRD and SMN. DEF 31, INT +4, MND +4; enhanced Resist Silence; converts 55 HP to MP.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

  1. Obtain Aquarian Abjuration: Head; original sources include Byakko.
  2. Obtain Cursed Crown -1 through crafting or the Auction House.
  3. Trade the abjuration and cursed item together to Alphollon C Meriard inside the cathedral in Northern San d'Oria.

Result

The uncursed armor is Rare/Exclusive. The high-quality result requires the -1 cursed item; an ordinary cursed item produces the ordinary armor.

articles.title: Zenith Mitts
articles.intro: Level-73 hands equipment for WHM, BLM, RDM, BRD and SMN. DEF 23, Magic Attack Bonus +5; converts 50 HP to MP.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

  1. Obtain Aquarian Abjuration: Hands; original sources include Genbu or Fafnir.
  2. Obtain Cursed Mitts through crafting or the Auction House.
  3. Trade the abjuration and cursed item together to Alphollon C Meriard inside the cathedral in Northern San d'Oria.

Result

The uncursed armor is Rare/Exclusive. Use the linked cursed-item page for its crafting recipe.

articles.title: Zenith Slacks
articles.intro: Level-73 legs equipment for WHM, BLM, RDM, BRD and SMN. DEF 40, MND +4, CHR +4, Evasion -3; converts 50 HP to MP.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

  1. Obtain Aquarian Abjuration: Legs; original sources include Seiryu or Suzaku.
  2. Obtain Cursed Slacks through crafting or the Auction House.
  3. Trade the abjuration and cursed item together to Alphollon C Meriard inside the cathedral in Northern San d'Oria.

Result

The uncursed armor is Rare/Exclusive. Use the linked cursed-item page for its crafting recipe.

articles.title: Zenith Pumps
articles.intro: Level-73 feet equipment for WHM, BLM, RDM, BRD and SMN. DEF 20, INT +2, CHR +2; converts 50 HP to MP.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

  1. Obtain Aquarian Abjuration: Feet; original sources include King Behemoth or Fafnir.
  2. Obtain Cursed Pumps through crafting or the Auction House.
  3. Trade the abjuration and cursed item together to Alphollon C Meriard inside the cathedral in Northern San d'Oria.

Result

The uncursed armor is Rare/Exclusive. Use the linked cursed-item page for its crafting recipe.

articles.title: Zunari Kabuto +1
articles.intro: High-quality level-44 Samurai head armor with DEF 16.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

High-quality result of the Zunari Kabuto recipe: Smithing 69 and Clothcraft 34; Fire Crystal + 2 Iron Sheets + 1 Copper Ingot + 1 Silk Thread + 1 Silk Cloth.

Purchase

Auction House → Armor → Head. The item’s displayed name is Zunari Kabuto +1.

articles.title: Zunari Kabuto Plus 1
articles.intro: High-quality level-44 Samurai head armor with DEF 16.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

High-quality result of the Zunari Kabuto recipe: Smithing 69 and Clothcraft 34; Fire Crystal + 2 Iron Sheets + 1 Copper Ingot + 1 Silk Thread + 1 Silk Cloth.

Purchase

Auction House → Armor → Head. The item’s displayed name is Zunari Kabuto +1.

articles.title: Zhayolm Fireflies
articles.intro: Temporary escape item supplied inside Zhayolm Remnants.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain and use

  1. Enter Zhayolm Remnants for Salvage. Each participant receives the temporary fireflies on entry.
  2. Use them when ready to leave the area. They return you to the Zhayolm entrance section of Alzadaal Undersea Ruins.

Before entering

The original event requires level 65+, the relevant Treasures of Aht Urhgan story progress, and a Remnants Permit. See Salvage for entry and equipment-restriction details.

articles.title: Zephyr Fan
articles.intro: Key item used to enter the original Bearclaw Pinnacle ENMs.
articles.body_html:
How to obtain

  1. Speak with Zebada near the entrance of Uleguerand Range to receive a Cotton Pouch.
  2. Climb the mountain, descend the western slope and land on the southern ledge near its base. Enter the cave.
  3. Trade the pouch to Chamnaet Spring for Chamnaet Ice.
  4. Return the ice to Zebada to receive the fan.

Use

Choose the route for Brothers, Follow the White Rabbit, Holy Cow, When Hell Freezes Over. Each battlefield page identifies its entrance; the entrances are not interchangeable.

articles.title: Zoni
articles.intro: Cooking soup with several small combat and recovery bonuses.
articles.body_html:
Craft or buy

Cooking 27: Fire Crystal + one each of Rock Salt, Sticky Rice, Tokopekko Wildgrass, San d'Orian Carrot, Tiger Cod, Distilled Water, Lakerda, Ziz Meat. Zoni is the ordinary result; Zesty Zoni is the high-quality result. Buy under Auction House → Food → Meals → Soups.

Food effect

3 hours: HP +10, MP +10; STR, DEX, VIT and AGI +1; Accuracy, Ranged Accuracy, Attack, Ranged Attack and Evasion +1; resting HP and MP recovery +1.

articles.title: Zesty Zoni
articles.intro: High-quality Cooking soup with several small combat and recovery bonuses.
articles.body_html:
Craft or buy

Cooking 27: Fire Crystal + one each of Rock Salt, Sticky Rice, Tokopekko Wildgrass, San d'Orian Carrot, Tiger Cod, Distilled Water, Lakerda, Ziz Meat. Zesty Zoni is the high-quality result of the Zoni recipe, not a separate guaranteed synthesis. Buy under Auction House → Food → Meals → Soups.

Food effect

4 hours: HP +12, MP +12; STR, DEX, VIT and AGI +2; Accuracy, Ranged Accuracy, Attack, Ranged Attack and Evasion +2; resting HP and MP recovery +1.

articles.title: Zhayolm Card
articles.intro: Salvage drop used to spawn Don Poroggo in a different Remnants area.
articles.body_html:
Obtain it

Defeat archaic machinery in the original Zhayolm Remnants. Confirmed sources include First Rampart, Second Rampart and Fourth Rampart.

Use it

  1. Take the card into the original Silver Sea Remnants. Choose a northern second-floor teleporter to reach the north section of floor three.
  2. Defeat the Devilet there to reveal the Slot.
  3. Trade the Zhayolm Card to the Slot to spawn Don Poroggo.
  4. Defeat it for the level-15 Salvage body components Enyo's Breastplate and Nemain's Robe.
